verdict.rationale: Graphite offers a documented CLI (gt commands) and an MCP server (gt-mcp) that let AI/agentic tooling drive the product, but there is no public REST/GraphQL/OpenAPI API — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API (REST/GraphQL) with endpoint reference, authentication scopes, and independent/hands-on corroboration of programmatic API usage beyond CLI/MCP.
